description: This source file defines the ListInfoOverrideRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering ListInfo objects in RTF format as part of the MigraDoc document rendering process. The class handles generating RTF control codes related to list overrides, maintaining a static mapping between ListInfo objects and their assigned list numbers.

classes.name: ListInfoOverrideRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for ListInfo objects, generating RTF code for list overrides in a document.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the static list number counter and clears the list number mapping.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Generates RTF control codes for a ListInfo object to override list settings in RTF.

methods.name: GetListNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the assigned list number for a given ListInfo object from the internal static mapping.
